title: The Sympathizer
author: Viet Thanh Nguyen
summary: A half-French, half-Vietnamese captain is a communist spy inside the South Vietnamese army. After Saigon falls he flees to California while still reporting to the North, writing a confession as he goes.
readIf: you like literary fiction with dark satire and an angle on the Vietnam War seldom told in English.
skipIf: you want a straightforward spy thriller or cannot read about torture.
